artifacts.notes: The photograph shows a paired low closed-shoe form with a shallow upper, low heel, taffeta covering, metallic-looking edge trim, vamp band, and bow-like closure or ornament. These are properties of this circa 1900-1950 Pisa exemplar only. Do not prescribe them as universal, infer hidden construction, use the display color as a complete color rule, or transfer the morphology to buskins.

edition.title: Manifattura italiana, sandali pontificali, in pelle rivestita di taffetas, 1900-50 ca., dal duomo di Pisa

work.author: Sailko, photographer
work.description: A documentary museum photograph of a pair of Italian pontifical sandals dated circa 1900-1950 from Pisa Cathedral. It is a bounded material-culture witness for one near-horizon pair, not evidence of a universal Roman cut, closure, textile, decoration, or color.
work.title: Pontifical sandals from Pisa Cathedral
